recipe.visualDefinition: A central, grey-skinned humanoid figure with large black eyes and a high-collared cape stands within a massive stone doorway. The figure holds a guitar shaped like a double-headed battle axe. The background features a dark sky with a single lightning bolt and orange flames licking the bottom of the frame. The entire scene is framed by heavy, textured stone blocks with iron rings.
coreVisualRelationships: The stone portal acts as a physical frame for the central character.
The orange fire at the base contrasts with the dark, lightning-streaked sky.
The metallic sheen of the axe-guitar contrasts with the matte texture of the stone.
coreInvariants: Symmetrical stone architecture framing the scene
Alien-like skull-shaped head with large almond eyes
High-contrast lighting from fire below and lightning above

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The guardian figure is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The alien's pale, skull-like head serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye moves from the top text area down the stone pillars to the fire, then upward to the central figure and the lightning bolt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space behind the figure emphasizes the lightning and the character's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (brown and grey) for the stone structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the interior sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow for the fire; stark white for the lightning.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the pale alien head and the black background; low saturation in the stone framing.

letterConstructionRules: Double-line or inline detailing within the strokes
Exaggerated descenders and ascenders that curve outward
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a long, sweeping left leg that curves into a hook.
Lower-tier text uses a more compressed, uniform height with similar inline detailing.

composition.relationshipToImage: engraved into the top stone lintel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, expressive title paired with a smaller, more uniform subtitle in the same stylistic family.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy metal fantasy aesthetic with inline details.
Provides the curved, ancient feel of the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Paint a massive stone portal with iron rings on the sides. Inside the portal, show a dark sky with a single white lightning bolt and orange flames at the bottom. In the center, place a pale alien figure in a high-collared black cape holding a guitar shaped like a battle axe.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom gothic lettering to the top stone beam. The letters should appear engraved with a double-line inline effect and flared, curved terminals.

verificationChecks: Is the alien head the brightest part of the central figure?
Does the fire appear to be behind the bottom edge of the stone portal?
Is the text centered and styled with fantasy-gothic flourishes?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the alien

mustAchieve: Sense of scale and weight in the stone

postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the iron rings on the stone pillars.
Ensure the lightning bolt is sharp and high-contrast.
Verify the guitar has both axe blades and strings.
Confirm the text looks like it is part of the stone structure.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [monolithic architecture] with [surreal guardian figure] using [high-contrast elemental lighting] and [engraved gothic typography].
